instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the correct spelling of the word.

atoms.b: I ((++frequently friquently frequintly frequentlee)) go on holiday to Italy.

atoms.b: We have a ((++marvellous marvelous marvillous marvellus)) view of the city from here.

atoms.b: He gave himself a ((++disastrous disaster disastris disaustros)) haircut.
atoms.finishSound: He gave himself a disastrous haircut.

atoms.b: What ((++profession proffession proffesion professoun)) do you want to have in the future?
atoms.finishSound: What profession do you want to have in the future?

atoms.b: My favourite ((++restaurant restarant restaurunt restaurent)) is a pizza place.
atoms.finishSound: My favourite restaurant is a pizza place.
